The detailer workflow is unavailable without this pack.

node_packs.notes: Provides UltralyticsDetectorProvider and installs ultralytics (AGPL-3.0) into the user's ComfyUI environment; neither kiln nor easel imports ultralytics. AGPL-3.0 section 13 duties fall on whoever exposes that ComfyUI as a network service. ultralytics may pip-install further packages at run time. The detailer workflow is unavailable without this pack.
